notes: Map key (NE photo) read first: Port (anchor in a white circle), Clear, Minor Road (double dashed tan line), Town (circle), Major Road (solid dark line), City (grid symbol in a white-outlined hex), River+Marsh hexside, Minor/Major River (blue, major thicker), Victory Point (red circle), Minor Airfield (white bar), Major Airfield (plane in grey circle), Lake (blue shape on a hexside), Marsh, Hill, Landmark (small white rectangle), Mountain Hexside (hexside covered by the dark shading), Mountain Peak (triangle + height), Mountain Pass ")(" across a hexside. No separate major-city symbol in the key.

Mountain hexsides: hexsides fully covered by the dark ridge shading (measured along each hexside on a lighting-normalised image, mtn_sides.py, then every candidate checked by eye in z2/mtn_*.jpg). Ridges: Pizzo San Salvatore massif (2614-2917), Caserta hills (2619/2720-2821), Monti di Avella / Cancello (2823-3025), and the Vesuvius cone (all land sides of 2327).

Rivers: the Volturno (major: light blue with dark edges, thicker) follows hexsides from the east photo edge (3019-3020) to its mouth on 1815-1816; Capua (2518) lies on its south bank. The Agnena Canal and Regi Lagni Canal are thin dark-navy lines, recorded as minor rivers; the Regi Lagni ends at the 2623/2624/2724 corner. Bridges = road crossing a river/canal hexside.
Roads were traced as centrelines in photo pixels (roads_trace.py), converted to hexside crossings (hexat.py, roads_x.py) and every crossing was checked on zoomed overlays (z2/x_*.jpg).

Naples is a 3-hex major city (2024, 2124, 2125: one city graphic, all three hexes white-outlined); ports (blue-filled anchor circles) in 2024 and 2125; major airfield in 2124. No VP circle in any Naples hex. Other cities: Capua 2518, Aversa 2220, Frattamaggiore 2222, Afragola 2323, Caserta 2620 (VP 1), Resina 2126, Nola 2726.
VP circles (all value 1): 2116 (empty clear hex north of the Volturno), 2515 (major road junction south of Sparanise), 2517 (Capua Airfield), 2620 (Caserta), 3019 (empty hill hex north of Limatola).
Two port symbols: white circle with dark anchor (the key's Port) at Chiaia 1924 and Pozzuoli 1723; blue-filled circle with white anchor at Naples 2024 and 2125.
Small bold numerals beside the Naples-Capua-Sparanise major road: 1 in 2125, 2 in 2122, 3 in 2320, 4 in 2518, 5 in 2515 (recorded as label).

Printed text without symbols: CAMPANIA PLAIN (large letters across 1820-2319), Gulf of Naples (1826/1827), NAPLES (Napoli) (1925/2025), Volturno (2215/2216), Agnena Canal (2014/2015), Regi Lagni Canal (2218/2318), Mondragone (1813, for the town in 1913), Sant'Agata de' Goti (3021/3022, town off photo).
Open sea has no printed hex outlines (only coastal sea hexes are outlined); sea hexes there were placed from the fitted grid.

Outside this photo but visible at its edges: Mondragone town (1913), Pozzuoli port (1723; roads to 1822 and 1823 confirmed), a minor road entering 2313 from the west to meet the major road at the top edge, and a blue river line at the very top-right corner (beyond 3013).
No Gustav Line, Bernhard Line, 8th Army boundary, 8th Army zone, garrison note or covering table on this photo; the only box is the S1 entry band.
